label: Bridge premise: for any GOD_4 with the classical attributes who can reveal…, from attested mandate
meaning: The bridge STMT-BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD is decomposed into four premises and proved from them; its universal reach over societies is carried by the scope premise: given a God with the classical attributes who can reveal recognizably, Jesus' claim and resurrection, and a visible authoritative society c Jesus founded, the resurrection is that God's confirmation that Jesus holds his mandate (attestation); what God confirms is true, so Jesus holds it (veracity); c was founded in the exercise of that mandate and commissioned to teach (scope); and what Jesus so founds in a God's mandate, that God founded as a teaching authority (envoy founding). Each premise is necessary (omissionModels, with every stage antecedent holding by modelSig_antecedents) and the four are jointly satisfiable with every stage antecedent (jointModel). All four premises are open; the result closes the bridge only relative to them. The decisive premise is the scope premise: whether the attested mandate covers founding an institution with a teaching commission, and whether every society in the bridge's antecedent is the commissioned one.

strong_version_needed.b139ab5a-695b-588a-b03d-b89659595ded: The conclusion ranges over every visible authoritative society Jesus founded. The registered weak sibling keeps both mandate-founding and teaching but only at the Catholic Church. CATHOLICISM-WEAK-MANDATE-SCOPE-DOES-NOT-FORCE-BRIDGE supplies a nonempty model of attestation, veracity, that weak scope and envoy transfer with the universal bridge false at a second founded visible society. The existing CATHOLICISM-MANDATE-SCOPE-FROM-CATHOLIC-CHURCH-FOUNDING already recovers the strong scope from the weak sibling plus stage6 identity on the root graph; that identity is not a premise of this four-input argument. No claim that teaching is removed by weakening is intended. CATHOLIC-AND-DISTINCT-BODY-SCOPE-COUNTERMODEL exports the stronger nonvacuity boundary explicitly: the same God actually mandates Jesus, the Catholic body is actually founded/visible, and a distinct other founded/visible body lacks divine teaching-founding. The weaker existential model alone did not expose these specific body witnesses.
